cs.t: I'm a big fan of Herman Miller tables (I use an Everywhere table [0] at home). They have a very modern, sleek aesthetic, come in all kinds of sizes and heights, and are EXTREMELY stable. I hate tables that jostle around when you touch them. Herman Miller is known for really expensive chairs, but a lot of his stuff is competitively priced with Sears et. al. and much higher quality in my opinion. Warning: you need an electric drill for assembly since the screw holes are not pre-drilled. [0]:  http://www.smartfurniture.com/products/Rectangular-Everywher...
